SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.

5. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.

7. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   B. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

10. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The School as rumours only.
   B. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   D. Say The School never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

13. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

15. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
